sql_reading_A.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL_KEY) AS total_subjects,
    SUM(d.FEE) AS total_fee,
    MIN(
        (TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, 'HH24:MI')
       - TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, 'HH24:MI')) * 24 * 60
    ) AS shortest_session_minutes,
    MAX(
        (TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, 'HH24:MI')
       - TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, 'HH24:MI')) * 24 * 60
    ) AS longest_session_minutes
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION s
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
WHERE LOWER(s.SESSION_LOCATION) = 'virtual';
